source: pystock-data (eliangcs; Yahoo Finance daily prices crawled each morning; raw unadjusted 'close' column) https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eliangcs/pystock-data/master/2015/0001_initial.tar.gz .. 0003_initial.tar.gz (2014-12-31) and daily archives https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eliangcs/pystock-data/master/{2015/20150401,2015/20150701,2015/20151001,2016/20160104,2016/20160401,2016/20160701,2016/20161003,2017/20170102}.tar.gz (prices.csv); primary for 2017-03-31/2017-06-30 and cross-check: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yumoxu/stocknet-dataset/master/price/raw/BHP.csv (Yahoo 'Close', 2012-09-04..2017-09-01). Value = last trading-day close on/before each calendar quarter end. ADR/NYSE listing; no public mirror found for later years, so coverage stops where the mirrors stop. Yahoo 'Close' is not adjusted for the 2015 South32 demerger (consistent with the not-dividend-adjusted basis).
